title.narrative: Integrated Health Program (IHP) Task Order Three (TO3)

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:.Provide health system support to the Bauchi State Government to plan, budget and coordinate the implementation of primary health care services in the state and advocate for improved health system governance and domestic resource mobilization. .Build the capacity of the health care workers (private & public) to provide equitable, quality primary health services and to reach underserved populations; .Issue small grants to local organizations to provide technical assistance and capacity building to support health facilities in provision of nutrition services, gender based violence (GBV) and informal sector enrollment in financial risk protection schemes; and .Promote the adoption of essential WASH actions such as handwashing and safe disposal of waste at the facility levels in Bauchi State. .This activity will strengthen health systems and increase access to and improve the quality of primary health care services in supported states in Nigeria. Interventions work in Bauchi State to support a multipartite MOU between the Bauchi State Government, USAID Nigeria, Gates Foundation, Global Affairs Canada, Dangote Foundation, and UNICEF. It aims to reduce maternal and child mortality in Bauchi, and to increase public and private health systems' skills to sustainably supervise and manage quality primary health care services. .This activity contributes to USAID priorities by focusing on evidence-based interventions, sustainability, localization and capacity building. It also contributes to USAID priorities by focusing on evidence-based interventions, sustainability, and capacity building. It also contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2, the Embassy's ICS, and is closely aligned with Goal 3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan..
